queries.sql: SELECT r.RegionName, YEAR(pay.Interval) AS [Year], ROUND(AVG(CAST(pay.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS AvgAQI, COUNT(CASE WHEN pay.Parametervalue > 100 THEN 1 END) AS HighDays, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN dc.IsActive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(dc.RecordedDate AS DATE)), 0), 1) AS DSR_Pct FROM ParameterAveragesYear pay JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pay.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Devices d ON p.DeviceID = d.DeviceId JOIN DMN_Stations s ON d.StationID = s.ID JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id LEFT JOIN DeviceCompliance dc ON dc.DeviceId = d.ID AND YEAR(dc.RecordedDate) = YEAR(pay.Interval) WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND YEAR(pay.Interval) > YEAR(GETDATE()) - @years AND YEAR(pay.Interval) <= YEAR(GETDATE()) GROUP BY r.RegionName, YEAR(pay.Interval) ORDER BY r.RegionName, YEAR(pay.Interval) ASC

queries.sql: SELECT pa.Interval, s.StationName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID IN (@stationId1, @stationId2) AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY pa.Interval, s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY pa.Interval, s.StationName

queries.description: Calculate the average, min, and max of a pollutant at a station over a date range
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as Average, MIN(pa.Parametervalue) as Minimum, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as Maximum, COUNT(*) as ReadingCount FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND p.ParameterName = @parameterName AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName

queries.description: Get all pollutant averages at a station for a date range — multi-pollutant overview
queries.sql: SELECT p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, AVG(pa.Parametervalue) as AvgValue, MIN(pa.Parametervalue) as MinValue, MAX(pa.Parametervalue) as MaxValue FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID WHERE pa.StationID = @stationId AND pa.Interval BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate AND pa.Status = 1 GROUP BY p.ParameterName, u.UnitName ORDER BY p.ParameterName

queries.description: Get all parameter readings (daily averages) for a specific site on a given PAST date. Uses SiteParameterAverages (TypeID=14440). ALWAYS prefer this over site_aqi_single when the question contains a specific date, year, or past time reference (e.g. 'on 2026-09-25', 'yesterday', 'last Monday'). Use when user asks: site readings on a date, what were the readings at a site on a date, all parameters at a site on a specific date.
patterns: what are the site readings at
what were the site readings at
what was the air quality at
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, spa.ParameterName, ROUND(spa.Parametervalue, 2) AS DailyAverage, (SELECT STRING_AGG(d.DeviceName + ' - ' + best.ParameterName, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.DeviceName) FROM (SELECT pa.DeviceID, p2.ParameterName, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.DeviceID ORDER BY pa.SubIndex DESC, pa.Parametervalue DESC) AS rn FROM ParameterAverages pa INNER JOIN DMN_Parameters p2 ON pa.ParameterID = p2.ID INNER JOIN DMN_Devices dv ON pa.DeviceID = dv.DeviceId AND ISNULL(dv.IsDeleted,0) = 0 WHERE pa.StationID = spa.StationID AND pa.TypeID = 1440 AND CAST(pa.Interval AS DATE) = CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) AND pa.Parametervalue IS NOT NULL AND p2.ParameterName != 'AQI Index') best INNER JOIN DMN_Devices d ON best.DeviceID = d.DeviceId WHERE best.rn = 1) AS MainPollutant, spa.DeviceCount, CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) AS [Date] FROM SiteParameterAverages spa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON spa.StationID = s.ID WHERE spa.TypeID = 14440 AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) = @date AND spa.Parametervalue IS NOT NULL ORDER BY spa.ParameterName

queries.description: Get the daily reading of a specific parameter (e.g. PM2.5, Temperature, CO, NO2, Humidity) at a specific site on a given date. Uses SiteParameterAverages (TypeID=14440). Use when user asks what was PM2.5 / Temperature / any specific parameter at a site on a date.

what was the aqi index at
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, spa.ParameterName, ROUND(spa.Parametervalue, 2) AS Reading, spa.DeviceCount, CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) AS [Date] FROM SiteParameterAverages spa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON spa.StationID = s.ID WHERE spa.TypeID = 14440 AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND spa.ParameterName LIKE '%' + @parameterName + '%' AND CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) = @date AND spa.Parametervalue IS NOT NULL ORDER BY spa.ParameterName

queries.description: Compare all parameter readings between two sites on a specific date using SiteParameterAverages (TypeID=14440). Use when user asks to compare site1 and site2 readings, or asks which site had better/worse air quality on a given day.
patterns: which site had better readings on
how do the two sites compare on
queries.sql: SELECT spa.ParameterName, MAX(CASE WHEN s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName1 + '%' THEN ROUND(spa.Parametervalue, 2) END) AS [@stationName1], MAX(CASE WHEN s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName2 + '%' THEN ROUND(spa.Parametervalue, 2) END) AS [@stationName2] FROM SiteParameterAverages spa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON spa.StationID = s.ID WHERE spa.TypeID = 14440 AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName1 + '%' OR (spa.TypeID = 14440 AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName2 + '%') AND CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) = @date AND spa.Parametervalue IS NOT NULL GROUP BY spa.ParameterName ORDER BY spa.ParameterName

queries.description: Get the stored monthly averages for a specific site for a given month and year. Uses SiteParameterAverages (TypeID=43200). Use when user asks about a named site's readings or AQI for a specific month (e.g. 'in March', 'for January 2025', 'last month at X'). ALWAYS use this instead of site_aqi_single when a month name is mentioned alongside a site name.

what was the aqi last month
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, spa.ParameterName, ROUND(spa.Parametervalue, 2) AS MonthlyAverage, spa.DeviceCount, FORMAT(spa.Interval, 'MMMM yyyy') AS [Month] FROM SiteParameterAverages spa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON spa.StationID = s.ID WHERE spa.TypeID = 43200 AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND YEAR(spa.Interval) = @year AND MONTH(spa.Interval) = @month AND spa.Parametervalue IS NOT NULL ORDER BY spa.ParameterName

queries.description: Get the stored yearly site averages for a specific site for a given year. Uses SiteParameterAverages (TypeID=365). Use when user asks about yearly average, annual average, or average for a specific year at a site.
patterns: what were the yearly readings at
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, spa.ParameterName, ROUND(spa.Parametervalue, 2) AS YearlyAverage FROM SiteParameterAverages spa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON spa.StationID = s.ID WHERE spa.TypeID = 365 AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND YEAR(spa.Interval) = @year AND spa.Parametervalue IS NOT NULL ORDER BY spa.ParameterName

queries.description: Show the daily trend of a specific parameter at a site over the last N days using stored site daily averages from SiteParameterAverages (TypeID=14440). Use when user asks about trend, history, or how a parameter changed over days at a site.
patterns: how did air quality change at
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (@days) s.StationName, spa.ParameterName, ROUND(spa.Parametervalue, 2) AS DailyAverage, spa.DeviceCount, CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) AS [Date] FROM SiteParameterAverages spa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON spa.StationID = s.ID WHERE spa.TypeID = 14440 AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND spa.ParameterName LIKE '%' + @parameterName + '%' AND spa.Parametervalue IS NOT NULL ORDER BY spa.Interval DESC

queries.description: Get the yearly average AQI (and all other parameters) for a specific site for a given year. Reads from ParameterAveragesYear (TypeID=365). Use when user asks 'what was the AQI at X in 2025' or 'air quality at X in 2024' — any question about a specific named site AND a specific past year (not an exact date). stationName and year are required.
queries.sql: SELECT s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, ROUND(AVG(CAST(pay.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 2) AS YearlyAverage, YEAR(pay.Interval) AS [Year] FROM ParameterAveragesYear pay JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pay.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pay.StationID = s.ID WHERE s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND YEAR(pay.Interval) = @year AND pay.Parametervalue IS NOT NULL AND pay.TypeID = 365 GROUP BY s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName, YEAR(pay.Interval) ORDER BY p.ParameterName

queries.description: List sites (schools or any sector) that repeatedly exceeded a given AQI threshold over the last 30 days AND still maintained a Data Success Rate (device active days / 30) of at least a given percentage (default 75%). Default AQI threshold is 100 and default DSR threshold is 75%. Uses SiteParameterAverages (TypeID=14440) for daily AQI and DeviceCompliance for device active-day counting. Use when user asks: which schools exceeded AQI 100 but had good data success rate, sites that repeatedly exceeded AQI [value] with at least [X]% data success rate, schools with high AQI but still active, sites exceeding AQI threshold with acceptable DSR, or any variation asking for AQI exceedance combined with data success/availability rate.

queries.sql: WITH DailyAQI AS ( SELECT spa.StationID, CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) AS ReadingDate, ROUND(MAX(CAST(spa.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS DailyAQI FROM SiteParameterAverages spa WHERE spa.TypeID = 14440 AND spa.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND spa.Parametervalue IS NOT NULL AND CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -30, GETDATE()) AS DATE) AND CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()) AS DATE) GROUP BY spa.StationID, CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) ), ExceedanceSummary AS ( SELECT StationID, COUNT(*) AS TotalReadingDays, SUM(CASE WHEN DailyAQI > @aqiThreshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DaysExceeded FROM DailyAQI GROUP BY StationID HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN DailyAQI > @aqiThreshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2 ), DeviceActivedays AS ( SELECT d.StationID, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(dc.RecordedDate AS DATE)) AS ActiveDays FROM DeviceCompliance dc JOIN DMN_Devices d ON dc.DeviceId = d.DeviceId WHERE dc.IsActive = 1 AND CAST(dc.RecordedDate AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -30, GETDATE()) AS DATE) AND CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()) AS DATE) GROUP BY d.StationID ) SELECT s.StationName, s.OrganizationName, s.Location, sec.SectorName, sub.SectorName AS SubSectorName, r.RegionName, es.DaysExceeded, es.TotalReadingDays, ISNULL(dad.ActiveDays, 0) AS DeviceActiveDays, ROUND(100.0 * ISNULL(dad.ActiveDays, 0) / 30.0, 1) AS DataSuccessRate_Pct FROM ExceedanceSummary es JOIN DMN_Stations s ON es.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN DeviceActivedays dad ON dad.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors sub ON s.SubSectorID = sub.Id LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND ROUND(100.0 * ISNULL(dad.ActiveDays, 0) / 30.0, 1) >= @dsrThreshold ORDER BY es.DaysExceeded DESC, s.StationName

params.name: aqiThreshold
params.note: The AQI value the user wants to check exceedance against. Defaults to 100 if not mentioned.

params.name: dsrThreshold
params.note: Minimum Data Success Rate percentage (active days / 30 * 100). Defaults to 75 if not mentioned.

queries.description: List sites (filtered by sector, subsector, region, or all) whose Data Success Rate over the last 30 days is BELOW a given threshold (default 75%). DSR = distinct active days in DeviceCompliance (IsActive=1) over the last 30 days / 30 * 100. Returns site name, sector, region, active days, total days (30), and DSR%. Use when user asks: school sites with DSR below 75%, sites with data success rate below X%, which sites have low/poor data success rate, sites failing DSR threshold, sites with DSR less than / under X%.

queries.sql: WITH DeviceActiveDays AS ( SELECT d.StationID, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(dc.RecordedDate AS DATE)) AS ActiveDays FROM DeviceCompliance dc JOIN DMN_Devices d ON dc.DeviceId = d.DeviceId WHERE dc.IsActive = 1 AND CAST(dc.RecordedDate AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -30, GETDATE()) AS DATE) AND CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()) AS DATE) GROUP BY d.StationID ), SiteDSR AS ( SELECT s.ID AS StationID, s.StationName, s.OrganizationName, s.Location, sec.SectorName, sub.SectorName AS SubSectorName, r.RegionName, ISNULL(dad.ActiveDays, 0) AS ActiveDays, ROUND(100.0 * ISNULL(dad.ActiveDays, 0) / 30.0, 1) AS DSR_Pct FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN DeviceActiveDays dad ON dad.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors sub ON s.SubSectorID = sub.Id LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND (@sectorName IS NULL OR sec.SectorName LIKE '%' + @sectorName + '%') AND (@regionName IS NULL OR r.RegionName LIKE '%' + @regionName + '%') ) SELECT StationName, OrganizationName, SectorName, SubSectorName, RegionName, ActiveDays, 30 AS TotalDays, DSR_Pct AS DataSuccessRate_Pct FROM SiteDSR WHERE DSR_Pct < @dsrThreshold ORDER BY DSR_Pct ASC, StationName

params.name: dsrThreshold
params.note: The DSR % ceiling — return sites BELOW this value. Defaults to 75 if not mentioned.

params.name: sectorName
params.note: Filter by sector. Extract from question: 'school' or 'education' maps to 'Education', 'health' or 'healthcare' maps to 'Healthcare', 'residential' maps to 'Residential', etc. Leave null for all sectors.

params.name: regionName
params.note: Filter by region name if mentioned (Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Al Dhafra). Leave null for all regions.
